name: API Routes
description: Next.js App Router API route handlers for events, Stripe webhooks, lead magnets, subscriptions, waitlists, and calendar endpoints.

name: Pages & Routes (UI)
description: Next.js App Router pages, layouts, route-segment content/forms, and route metadata (sitemap, robots, global styles) for marketing, giveaways, sessions, events, lead magnets, and the resource vault.

name: Shared UI Components
description: Reusable React UI components: animations, hero/video, header/footer, cards, navigation, and giveaway/event modals shared across pages.

name: Session & Page Content
description: Per-session content checklist components plus reusable page/guide templates that supply structured content to routes.

name: Domain & Data Libraries
description: Domain logic and data-access libraries: events catalog, checkout, Stripe, Supabase client, email, calendar, tokens, locks, sessions, and utilities.

name: Database (Migrations & Schema)
description: Supabase SQL migrations defining tables, constraints, rate-limit/cron locks, and abandoned-checkout schema.

name: Ops Scripts
description: Standalone operational and automation scripts for abandoned-checkout runs, reconciliation, backfills, reminders, and PDF rendering.

name: Tests
description: Automated test suite covering checkout, email, tokens, calendar, pricing, validation, and hardening.

name: Documentation & Static Assets
description: Project docs, agent/skill guides, and static HTML/markdown/download assets served publicly or used for reference.

name: Build & Tooling Config
description: Build, TypeScript, deployment, styling, and tooling configuration files.
